subject: Re: Audit logs not showing up in Contoso SIEM (exporter delays)
body:
From: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@contoso.example>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.example>
Cc: security-ops@contoso.example
Date: Tue, Feb 11, 2026 at 4:08 PM
Subject: Audit logs not showing up in Contoso SIEM (exporter delays)

Hi Naomi,

We’re seeing Redwood audit events arrive in bursts with ~1–2 hour delays since yesterday. This is via the audit-log-exporter that pushes to our SIEM ingest endpoint. We didn’t change our endpoint rate limits.

Can you confirm whether there’s an issue on Redwood’s side or any recommended config? We need near-real-time audit trails for our internal controls.

Thanks,
Ravi

---
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.example>
To: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@contoso.example>
Date: Tue, Feb 11, 2026 at 5:02 PM
Subject: Re: Audit logs not showing up in Contoso SIEM (exporter delays)

Ravi — thanks for flagging. We’ve seen a small number of cases where the audit-log-exporter can fall behind under backpressure and then “catch up” in bursts.

I’m looping in our support team to track this formally (ticket SUP-4855). Could you share:
- exporter version/tag
- avg event rate
- whether you see any 429/5xx responses on your ingest endpoint

---
From: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@contoso.example>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.example>
Date: Wed, Feb 12, 2026 at 12:11 AM
Subject: Re: Audit logs not showing up in Contoso SIEM (exporter delays)

Exporter tag is v1.9.2. We see mostly 200s; no 429s on our side. Event rate is low (<< 5/s).

---
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.example>
To: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@contoso.example>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.example>
Date: Wed, Feb 12, 2026 at 12:41 AM
Subject: Re: Audit logs not showing up in Contoso SIEM (exporter delays)

Thanks Ravi — we’re investigating a potential queue/backoff bug in v1.9.2 that can cause delayed flushes even without explicit 429s. We’ll follow up in SUP-4855 with next steps and a patched version if confirmed.
